title: Understanding K-means Clustering
text: K-means clustering is sensitive to the initial placement of centroids. Think about how starting points might influence the final clusters.

title: Exploring Initial Centroid Placement
text: Consider how different initial positions for centroids might lead to different paths of convergence. What does this imply about the final cluster assignments?

hintAnswer: Initial centroids can lead to different final clusters.
title: Evaluating the Impact of Initial Centroids
text: Which of the following statements is true about the impact of initial centroid placement in K-means clustering?
choices: Initial centroids have no impact on final clusters.
Initial centroids can lead to different final clusters.
